limits: 365 days of 2026, community tier (Mawaqit mosque-platform table, not a state body)
coordinates are the mosque page's own (Gakpe), east of the Cotonou point
the captured table is not Cotonou geometry: it reproduces at 11.12 N / 2.97 E, so no recipe fits the stated point and none is graded there
_meta.reading: margins are minutes added to the raw computed time before the printed rounding; exact/within1/worst are per-prayer day counts; zeroMargin is the recipe as published with no margin and nearest rounding

impliedGeometry.why: at the stated Cotonou coordinates the table cannot be reproduced (see best.perPrayer: worst 9 min); sunrise and dhuhr residuals trace a clean annual sinusoid, which is a latitude difference, not a clock difference
impliedGeometry.method: latitude from the sunrise residual amplitude, longitude from the dhuhr residual level (4 min per degree), then the full fit re-run there
impliedGeometry.nearestPlace: Kandi, Benin (11.13 N, 2.94 E), 3 km from the implied point
